correctness.rationale: From the exact ODE, (log y)dot=x-1 and (log z-2a log y)dot=a(x-1)^2+a-b. Bounded positive persistence bounds logarithms, giving sharp Cesaro moments and excluding b<a. At b=a, monotone bounded W gives finite integral of (x-1)^2; bounded derivatives imply x tends to 1 and xdot to 0; monotonic inversion of (y+az,W) selects one equilibrium. For b>a, applying (M-x)(x-m)>=0 to exact first and second Cesaro moments yields (M-1)(1-m)>=b/a-1 and the amplitude bound. The compact invariant-measure argument integrates a nonnegative continuous coboundary. verify.py tests 144 exact rational parameter-state samples, 12 critical Jacobians, and 4000 RK4 steps; finite tests are not proof.

value.rationale: For a model studied for coexistence cycles and chaos, an exact predator-mortality-only constraint on the RMS deviation of prey, independent of c and valid even on nonperiodic persistent trajectories, is a quantitative restriction absent from qualitative stability diagrams. The bound M-m>=2 sqrt(b/a-1) supplies a physically interpretable minimum oscillation range. Critical compact-interior convergence excludes hidden nontrivial recurrence at the line of equilibria. These are motivated structural statements useful for dynamic feasibility and numerical calibration, not arbitrary parameter slices or computations.
